common.name: Name
common.noData: No data for this hub yet.
common.cohortNote: Counts below ten are never shown, so no one can be singled out.

errors.own_account: You cannot service your own account.
errors.account_erased: This account was erased; only the tombstone notice remains.
errors.cooling_off_active: The 72-hour cooling-off period has not ended yet.
errors.conflict_of_interest: You declared a conflict of interest with this company; another reviewer decides.
errors.sanctions_match: A potential sanctions match blocks approval until the screening case is decided.
errors.steps_incomplete: Required recipe steps have not passed yet.
errors.recipe_missing: A checked claim needs a verification recipe before the type can be activated.
errors.out_of_bounds: This value is outside the allowed range.
errors.original_decider: You made the original decision; a different person decides the appeal.
errors.grant_too_long: A case grant lasts at most 72 hours.
errors.too_many_objects: A case grant names at most 100 objects of one type.
errors.case_required: Choose an open case about this account first.
errors.baseline_locked: This safeguard is always on and cannot be changed.
errors.objection_received: The account owner objected; the change was cancelled.
errors.no_representative: This company has no active representative.
errors.type_inactive: This credential type is not active.
errors.release_permission: Only the hub owner role releases method versions.

outcomes.second_person: Demo: this would create a second-person request to “{action}”; nothing is saved.
outcomes.pending_second: Demo: a second person would complete this in Approvals; nothing is saved.
outcomes.grant_requested: Demo: the grant request would go to a different support lead for approval; nothing is saved.
outcomes.cooling_off: Demo: this would take effect on {date}; the account owner would be told on every verified channel. Nothing is saved.
outcomes.notified: Demo: the person concerned would be notified; nothing is saved.
outcomes.version: Demo: this would be saved as a new version; nothing is saved.
outcomes.case_opened: Demo: a case would be opened; nothing is saved.

people.title: People
people.lede: People in this hub as the public sees them, with account-state counts. Private profiles never appear here.
people.publicOnly: Only public profiles are listed. Staff never edit a person's profile; they can flag it for moderation.
people.noProfiles: No public profiles in this hub yet.

flagCategories.impersonation_report: Reported as pretending to be someone else

people.flagNote: Flagging opens a moderation case; the profile content stays as the person wrote it.

companies.title: Companies
companies.lede: The company directory as staff manage it: sourced, claimed and verified companies, identifiers, re-checks and representatives.
companies.badgeRule: An identifier never upgrades a company: verification comes only from a claim decided with its recipe. Verified never means good.
companies.none: No companies in this hub yet.
companies.sourcedNote: Built from public sources within the hub's legal basis; they stay labelled sourced until the company claims them.
companies.takedownBanner: A takedown request is pending for a sourced page:
companies.revokeNote: The company is notified; the public page shows the reason category only.
companies.suspendRepNote: The company is notified; its administrators can resume the representative after fixing the cause.

claims.title: Claims
claims.lede: Decide company claims step by step with the hub's recipe and the evidence.
claims.recipeRule: Approve to claimed after the register match and the signatory tie; to verified only when every required step has passed.
claims.evidenceViewer: Evidence viewer under the claim review grant
claims.sanctionsBlock: Potential sanctions match: this claim cannot be approved until the screening case is decided.
claims.appealNote: Appeal against a rejection, deadline {deadline}. Original decider:

verification.title: Verification
verification.lede: Recipes, check providers and screening lists the hub uses to verify claims.
verification.screeningAlwaysOn: Baseline sanctions screening is part of every recipe and has no switch.
verification.costNote: A hub may charge for the cost of a check, never for its result.
verification.liveNote: Switching a provider to live needs a second person.
verification.addList: Add a list from the country pack

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.lede: Verifiable credentials the hub issues: checked facts that holders keep and present anywhere.
credentials.notAScore: A credential is a checked fact, never a score, and is never sold.
credentials.subject: Holder
credentials.saveType: Save the type as a new version
credentials.recipeRule: These claims are checked and need a recipe before activation: {claims}.
credentials.holderSearch: Search by holder within a case
credentials.issueRule: A credential is issued only from a recorded decision with evidence.
credentials.evidenceCount: {count, plural, one {# evidence item} other {# evidence items}}
credentials.credentialIdHelp: From the case; holders are found only within a case.
credentials.revokeNote: Revocation is an entry in the hub's status list; the public reason is the category only.

consents.title: Consents
consents.lede: Consent and portrait licence records, and withdrawals waiting for unpublication.
consents.records: Records by kind, version and state
consents.processNote: The content is unpublished and the person is told when it is done.
consents.subject: Person id
consents.subjectHelp: The id from the support case or the claim.

actions.require_password_reset: Require a password reset at next sign-in

lookup.title: Support lookup
lookup.lede: Find the person or company you are helping. Every lookup serves a case and is recorded in the access log.
lookup.logged: E-mail addresses are matched exactly and never shown in full.
lookup.needsCase: Choose the case this lookup serves; nothing is searched without one.
lookup.loggedFor: Recorded in the access log for case {case}.

account.title: Account card
account.lede: Diagnose and service an account without becoming the person: an allowlist of facts, no private content.
account.noImpersonation: There is no way to sign in as a participant or act with their authority, and staff never manage a participant's own agent, mandates, settings, goals or connections. Use the alternatives below.
account.ownAccount: You cannot service your own account.
account.erased: This account was erased. Only this notice remains.
account.factorMethods: {count, plural, one {# method enrolled} other {# methods enrolled}}
account.allowlist: Shown: only these facts. Never message bodies, private projects, budgets, session tokens, addresses or a location trail.
account.metadataOnly: Delivery metadata only: the template and its version, never the message body or private values.
account.needsCase: Open a case about this account first.
account.guidedTaskHelp: The person performs the steps in their own session.
account.evidenceRecorded: Identity evidence was checked and recorded (needed to change the recovery e-mail or reset the second factor)
account.coolingOffRule: Changing the recovery e-mail or the second factor needs evidence, a different approver and a 72-hour cooling-off; the person is told on every verified channel and can object.
account.alternatives: Instead of acting as the person
account.noPublic: This person has no public profile.
account.ownAgent: Anything the person wants done for them: their own agent, under their own mandate, if they choose.

company.title: Company card
company.lede: Help a company: its public page, claim and verification state, public members and representative.
company.publicOnly: Never shown: private projects, requests for quotes, quotes, budgets or messages.
company.requestGrant: Request a case grant on named objects

cases.title: Support cases
cases.lede: Cases and their grants. A case thread stays inside the case; there is no general inbox.
cases.subject: Subject
cases.detailLede: The thread with the person, diagnostics they shared, grants and every read under them.
cases.snapshotNote: Shared by the person from their own session, with only the objects they selected.
cases.noReads: No reads under a grant yet.
cases.subjectIdHelp: The person's or company's id from the lookup.

grants.title: Case grants
grants.rule: A grant names up to 100 objects of one type, a projection class and a purpose, lasts at most {hours} hours and is approved by a different person. Every read is logged.
grants.excluded: Always excluded: private negotiation terms, credentials and payment references.
grants.bindsDigest: Your decision binds this exact request; a changed request needs a new one.
grants.notFoundAgain: The objects are not found again.
grants.requestSubmit: Ask a different person to approve
grants.idsHelp: Up to 100 ids of one type, separated by commas or spaces.

recovery.title: Recovery escalations
recovery.lede: Sign-in factor changes in progress: recovery e-mail changes and second-factor resets.
recovery.rule: Every change needs evidence and a different approver, then waits {hours} hours while every verified channel is told. An objection from the account owner cancels it.
recovery.objection: The account owner objected: the change was cancelled automatically and flagged.
recovery.approveNote: Approval starts the {hours}-hour cooling-off; the account owner is told on every verified channel.

explain.title: Access explainer
explain.lede: Answer “why can't they see or do this” with the policy decision, never the object's content.

reasons.no_participation: They do not take part in it.
reasons.capability_missing: Their role does not include this action.
reasons.membership_permission_missing: Their company role does not include this permission.
reasons.mandate_scope: The mandate does not cover this.
reasons.email_unverified: Their e-mail is not verified yet.
reasons.step_up_required: They need to confirm it is them first.
reasons.lifecycle: The object is not in a state that allows this.
reasons.public_projection: Everyone sees the published public version.

explain.noContent: The object's content is never shown here.
explain.noDecision: No decision recorded for this pair.
explain.copy: Add the explanation to the case reply

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.lede: Reports and cases decided under the hub's community rules, mapped to local law.
moderation.levelRule: Levels 1 to 3 apply at once; level 4 needs a second person.
moderation.nothingToDecide: No case is waiting for a decision.

disputes.title: Disputes
disputes.lede: Execution and review disputes decided on evidence under the dispute grant.
disputes.rule: Missing data counts as unknown, never as a failure, and payment never weighs.
disputes.evidenceGrant: Evidence viewer under the dispute grant
disputes.excludeNote: The observation stops counting until the dispute is resolved.

reputation.title: Reputation methods
reputation.lede: Explainable method versions: drafted, reviewed, released by the hub owner and explained in every hub language.
reputation.noScore: No control here edits a score. Reputation changes only through released method versions whose local parameters stay inside the engine's bounds.
reputation.releaseRule: Only the hub owner role releases a version.
reputation.nothingToRelease: No version is waiting for release.

appeals.title: Appeals
appeals.lede: One queue for appeals against claims, credentials, moderation decisions and observations.

screening.title: Screening
screening.lede: Sanctions compliance: lists, matches decided by people, jurisdiction holds and re-screening.
screening.stale: Screening unavailable: payments and commitments are paused until the baseline lists are fresh again.
screening.rule: No control loosens matching, pauses a baseline list or clears a hold without a reason.
screening.underCase: Names side by side, under case {case}

confirmations.title: Confirmations
confirmations.lede: Honest confirmation requests: only real counterparties of linked transactions or projects, in bounded volume.

fields.requireLink: Requires a linked transaction or project

confirmations.agentsNever: Agents may request confirmations but never confirm; that stays with people.
confirmations.patternsNote: Patterns are described by their shape, not by the people in them; opening a case is how they are reviewed.
